name: checkbox
useFor: Use for independent options applied when a form is submitted (exclude floodplain, layers to show). Pass the label as children so a click on it toggles the box. Use the indeterminate state for a parent that covers some of its children. For a setting that applies at once use Switch.
constraints: A checkbox that acts at once like a switch
source: Figma "UI · Controls" (442:145): Exclude floodplain, on and off
title: Checkbox
description: A 16px square with no cut: Bone inside a 1px Stone line when off, Forest with Mireye's Bone check when on, Forest with a Bone rule when mixed. An empty box steps to Fog under the pointer. Its label is 13px Forest 12px after it.
